scenes.headline: What if computers could create?
scenes.body: Not just calculate. Not just search. Actually create.
scenes.narration: What if computers could create? Not just calculate and not just search, but actually create.

scenes.headline: That's Generative AI
scenes.body: It can create text, images, audio, video and code.
scenes.narration: This is the idea behind generative AI. It can create text, images, audio, video, and even software code.

scenes.headline: How does it work?
scenes.body: Generative AI learns patterns from large amounts of existing data.
scenes.narration: Generative AI learns patterns from large amounts of existing data, then uses those patterns to generate new content.
